answer: Tag every connection with transport fingerprints: TCP timestamp replies reveal host clock skew, TLS handshake exposes the stack, and ping latency to three beacons maps its network home. Identities sharing one fingerprint atlas belong to one machine, so the node freezes all but the first key until each shows an independent host proof. Detection is falcon-fast, landing on first contact, and forcing every identity onto physically separate hardware pushes farm costs to their profit-breaking summit — scale no longer pays.
